groups.modifications: Three-pane composition and selected coherent CSS rule families; direct sash/swipe algorithms; props narrowed to task/run data. Add keyboard focus and inert drawers. Delete composer, PTY, plugin slots, filesystem tree and model/provider administration. Correct open-drawer drag offset. Chrome restyle: TopBar brand/chip/tb-tab/panel-toggle and data-tip families, lp-section/session-item sidebar rows, pill inspector tabs, msg-meta/body transcript cards, statusbar, empty-state and scrollbar rules; generic controls use zero-specificity :where() so family classes win; phones wrap the topbar into an action row and an icon tab row. Fine-pointer controls follow pi's 24–28px density and coarse pointers keep 32–36px minimum targets; the earlier universal 44px controls were replaced. Accessible names are unchanged and every safety statement stays fully visible, wrapping in the scope bar, statusbar and collapsed episode rows instead of being clipped or hidden; small statements, selected tabs and the primary button use AA-contrast tokens. Interface text, including accessible names, is keyed by its English source and shown in English or Simplified Chinese; a topbar chip switches the language. Alert lines inside action dialogs keep the error colour rather than the dimmed dialog paragraph colour. Conversation-first refinement: one-service project section, independent active roster, paged task/run/subagent history, secondary Details menu and optional task-bound inspector; no cross-project/session import. Default Markdown text with folded complete metadata preserves visible limitations and exact child snapshot links. Conversation-first empty entry shares the existing layout, sidebar entry points and welcome presentation; folder selection stays in the bottom-right picker, and the entry history section explains per-project history and lists recent projects, one click on which is their explicit Open; one central Open a folder… action replaces the entry's New conversation. Returning to the last project is readonly navigation to a running owner. No unbound chat or automatic project activation. Recorded views appear only for a task/child scope (an ordinary conversation folds its tools into the transcript), and the current snapshot's owner run projection heads the retained run pages in one Runs view. The task inspector is now readonly retained content/check/change/review evidence; Legacy task creation is removed. Workflow history is an on-demand paged exact-ID listing, not a second executor. The subagent dock sizes to its rows up to its former fixed height until a drag sets one. Automatic recovery adds a one-time recovery notice above the workspace (dismissed per browser) and rewords the registry-busy refusal to name cadence doctor. The composer model panel replaces the topbar Model chip and owner-model dialog; a More menu holds refresh, disconnect and build information; Running conversations lists only live replies. The More menu and the entry topbar open the Cadence service dialog: version, an explicit installation-aware npm/Bun registry check, and a confirmed restart or upgrade that runs outside the service while the page waits for its recorded outcome. A conversation row names its live workflow's phase ahead of its reply status.
Readonly tree/collapse/orphan traversal remains. The legacy plan editor, prospective task plan adapter and Save/Generate/Start controls are retired; current conversation workflows own plan approval.

Direct lazy-window/height-hysteresis and collapsible card families; readonly Message/Tool composition narrowed to actual HistoryRecord owners/versions/associations. Direct Markdown/math/highlight/code-lines and streaming segmentation/smoothing modules. Remove executable fence/widget registration and pi-file paths. Safe link policy; omit images/media; optional raw HTML sanitized before nontrusted KaTeX/highlighting. Copy fallback restores focus and removes temporary DOM in finally. Streaming renderer is ported, not a claim of a live-text channel absent from current service projections.

Direct ToC/slug and SCM renderDiff, preview raw/Markdown/line-range/zoom composition. Bind only to retained content; page-local line numbers and captured-versus-current coverage explicit. No file editor, arbitrary host paths, HTML iframe/script enablement, attachments, Git stage/reset/commit or shell. Native checks/human review come from shared facts.

Reuse debounced request correlation, keyboard/result sections, exact DOM-range scroll/highlight helpers, fragment links and anchor download interaction. Replace ambient files/projects/plugins/session restoration with immutable scoped hits. Data/progress/snapshot handled in new reader adapters. No token storage/URL replay, timestamp guesses or giant Blob export. Native download explicitly requested/unverified; local page highlighting capped and labeled separately from complete durable search.

Direct whole standalone DOM client, not a replacement chart: lanes/list/four detail tabs/filter/zoom/follow/replay/resize/dispose retained. Finite typed read bridge instead of plugin send. Only pinned local vis import/CSS. Remove clear-history, CDN fallback, private redraw, external plugin update messages and active-window inference. Page ordinal/committed sequence visual axis; no browser clock extension of native spans, model-text timing, inferred file-change analysis or execution replay. Serial revision removes dormant live-clock/idle/prose analysis, reports missing vendor as degraded, shows recorded clock domains, and externalizes all 15 exact pinned vendor CSS literals. Its language now comes from the WebUI through the bridge (the client's own toggle is removed), and its remaining hard-coded English labels joined its catalog.

Adapt stale-socket generation/bounded reconnect and immutable same-entity append algorithm. Shared ProjectionTracker alone reduces execution projections; no copied upstream UiState/schema. Native dialog/focus replaces extension response sender. Finite preflight/named command/cancel/exact receipt; no automatic action retry or confirmation renewal. Disconnect/Return detaches, not Cancel. Legacy task preflight/confirmation UI is removed; retained receipts, model selection, dialogs and independent Cancel remain. A dialog without a close handler cannot be dismissed while a service restart is in progress.

Real installed Vite production build with fixed flat names, all 60 fonts, separate vis CSS, no dotenv/public/CDN/source maps. Two new private outputs must match before publication; --check is nonmutating. Source/contract/build identities are local, not server-echo compatibility. W7 final package/member/license and shared build handshake remain pending.

Adapt bottom composer, message/tool presentation, local directory browsing and cwd-picker layout to finite Cadence APIs. Remove upstream subagent/goal/delegate/plan engines, prompt composer/personas, PTY, plugin slots, SSH and file mutations. Ordinary turns use the existing Cadence native launcher and checkout gate, not task records. Explicit project opening navigates to a distinct owner; ordinary drafts and Cadence task mode are kept per conversation. Drawer focus cannot horizontally scroll the translating layout. The folder picker drops the separate Browse step for a location trail, Enter-to-go path entry, a folder filter and a named Open target; Open of a typed or recent path first observes it and opens only that canonical folder. A turn keeps one speaker label: its steps through the last tool call fold into one summary line, split into ChatSteps, and the text after them is the answer. Workflow research/implementation/review subagents join the agent dock beside legacy task children and open their transcript and retained result in a main-area view; each workflow is one line after the turn it started in, opening its own main-area view of steps, checks and delivery, instead of a card of every step below the newest message. The subagent dock heading leads its total with the queued or running count. Automatic recovery adds a one-time recovery notice above the workspace (dismissed per browser) and rewords the registry-busy refusal to name cadence doctor. The composer's model button opens an anchored, searchable model panel with a separate thinking row, a Send without a model waits there for one explicit choice, a Cadence mode switch replaces the mode select and the empty subagent dock stays folded. Whole-turn capture is paged by the owner; the chat transcript is one continuous, lazily mounted list of turns read by position, with tool detail read when a step opens, and no conversation or transcript page is switched. Checkpoints stream and persist per-message hash-chain records rather than a single capped context file; no consent, replay, migration or cleanup behavior is added. Conversation counts and turn counts no longer gate admission. The sidebar has bounded recent-first history scans/pages and a separate live roster; immutable ordinal slots keep metadata finite while extending old prefixes on explicit Send. Recent control links are a projection over durable workflow associations, not an attempt cap. Activity discovery adds activity-only native reports and bounded readonly registry-owner summaries, separate from history outcomes and control authority. Activity attribution uses immutable admission context, not copied/forked history or the retired workflow-link index. Directory/session navigation remains nonactivating and configuration-bound; source counts are deduplicated and partial observation never proves completion.
